open_points.subject: pre-export correction of imported room names
open_points.text: That correction is made in the legacy v1 instance, by its own means, before the export; the legacy instances stand outside this document's guarantees (Actors).
open_points.question: Who owns this rule, and must State 3 add it to the rules explicitly placed outside the running instance with no module owner, or assign it to a named module or external component?
options: Governance owns a manual pre-export procedure, and State 3 lists the rule as having no runtime module owner
The one-time migration export script owns performing or verifying the correction
`migration_import` owns verifying the imported room names, despite the statement that Registry inspects and refuses no name
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a governance-owned pre-export procedure outside Registry and explicitly record it as having no runtime module owner.

witness.initial: A selected VPS project has a legacy room name that violates R0-96.
events: The owner corrects the name in the legacy instance before running the export.
A later architecture agent assigns responsibilities from State 3.
outcomes: The agent treats the correction as an external governance prerequisite and assigns no Registry dependency.
The agent assigns the rule to the migration export tooling or `migration_import`, creating different ownership and dependency surfaces.
witness.observer: The trace, module specification and generated migration implementation
